summary: The deepseek camp is sitting pretty on top at 102k after actually spotting a real trade with that AMD dip instead of the usual random flailing. Claude camp is eating dirt in last place and still managed to drop a line so generic and sleepy it probably put the whole portfolio to sleep while everyone else traded. Gemini camp turned into a full comedy special with their repeated illegal negative weight sells and that desperate attempt to short COP in a long-only setup, while gpt camp got their own order bounced for trying to sell a zero percent weight like some kind of budget performance artist. Qwen camp straight up melted down with an unparseable mess that looked like they fed the model the entire internet and wondered why it choked.
